1.zh: 为基督耶稣被囚的保罗，同兄弟提摩太写信给我们所亲爱的同工腓利门，
1.en: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, andTimothy our brother,

1.zh: 和妹子亚腓亚并与我们同当兵的亚基布，以及在你家的教会。
1.en: To Philemon our dear friend and fellow worker, to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier and to the church that meets in your home:

1.zh: 愿恩惠 、 平安从神我们的父和主耶稣基督归与你们！
1.en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 我祷告的时候提到你，常为你感谢我的神；
1.en: I always thank my God as I remember you in my prayers,

1.zh: 因听说你的爱心并你向主耶稣和众圣徒的信心（或作：因听说你向主耶稣和众圣徒有爱心有信心）。
1.en: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.

1.zh: 愿你与人所同有的信心显出功效，使人知道你们各样善事都是为基督做的。
1.en: I pray that you may be active in sharing your faith, so that you will have a full understanding of every good thing we have in Christ.

1.zh: 兄弟阿，我为你的爱心，大有快乐，大得安慰，因众圣徒的心从你得了畅快。
1.en: Your love has given me great joy and encouragement, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.

1.zh: 我虽然靠著基督能放胆吩咐你合宜的事；
1.en: Therefore, although in Christ I could be bold and order you to do what you ought to do,

1.zh: 然而像我这有年纪的保罗，现在又是为基督耶稣被囚的，宁可凭著爱心求你，
1.en: yet I appeal to you on the basis of love. I then, as Paul--an old man and now also a prisoner of Christ Jesus--

1.zh: 就是为我在捆锁中所生的儿子阿尼西母（就是有益处的意思）求你。
1.en: I appeal to you for my son Onesimus, who became my son while I was in chains.

1.zh: 他从前与你没有益处，但如今与你我都有益处。
1.en: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.

1.zh: 我现在打发他亲自回你那里去，他是我心上的人。
1.en: I am sending him--who is my very heart--back to you.

1.zh: 我本来有意将他留下，在我为福音所受的捆锁中替你伺候我。
1.en: I would have liked to keep him with me so that he could take your place in helping me while I am in chains for the gospel.

1.zh: 但不知道你的意思，我就不愿意这样行，叫你的善行不是出于勉强，乃是出于甘心。
1.en: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that any favor you do will be spontaneous and not forced.

1.zh: 他暂时离开你，或者是叫你永远得著他，
1.en: Perhaps the reason he was separated from you for a little while was that you might have him back for good--

1.zh: 不再是奴仆，乃是高过奴仆，是亲爱的兄弟。在我实在是如此，何况在你呢！这也不拘是按肉体说，是按主说，
1.en: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a dear brother. He is very dear to me but even dearer to you, both as a man and as a brother in the Lord.

1.zh: 你若以我为同伴，就收纳他，如同收纳我一样。
1.en: So if you consider me a partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.

1.zh: 他若亏负你，或欠你甚么，都归在我的账上，
1.en: If he has done you any wrong or owes you anything, charge it to me.

1.zh: 我必偿还。这是我保罗亲笔写的。我并不用对你说，连你自己也是亏欠于我。
1.en: I, Paul, am writing this with my own hand. I will pay it back--not to mention that you owe me your very self.

1.zh: 兄弟阿，望你使我在主里因你得快乐（或作：益处）并望你使我的心在基督里得畅快。
1.en: I do wish, brother, that I may have some benefit from you in the Lord; refresh my heart in Christ.

1.zh: 我写信给你，深信你必顺服，知道你所要行的，必过于我所说的。
1.en: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.

1.zh: 此外你还要给我预备住处；因为我盼望藉著你们的祷告，必蒙恩到你们那里去。
1.en: And one thing more: Prepare a guest room for me, because I hope to be restored to you in answer to your prayers.

1.zh: 为基督耶稣与我同坐监的以巴弗问你安。
1.en: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings.

1.zh: 与我同工的马可 、 亚里达古 、 底马 、 路加 、 也都问你安。
1.en: And so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas and Luke, my fellow workers.

1.zh: 愿我们主耶稣基督的恩常在你的心里。阿们！
